setup_man_role: add a sphinx man role that creates clickable links to man pages in RST documentation
create_man_link_node: create a docutils reference node linking to a man page URL using a configurable regex template
parse_man_role_text: parse man page reference text like socket(2) to extract the name and section number using regex
configure_man_url_regex: configure a custom man page URL regex template via the sphinx app config value man_url_regex
register_sphinx_plugin: register the man role and man_url_regex config value with a sphinx application using the setup function
